paper_title: Multi-Agent-as-Judge: Aligning LLM-Agent-Based Automated Evaluation with Multi-Dimensional Human Evaluation

evidence.primary: Each panel contains dense bullet lists with small font, creating high text density and heavy reading burden across the entire poster.

secondary_issues.visual_hierarchy_weak: The main contribution (MAJ-EVAL framework) is not visually emphasized; all panels have similar visual weight, making it hard to identify the key result first.
secondary_issues.space_imbalance: The right column (Experiments/Results, Conclusion/Takeaways) has significantly more white space than the left and middle columns, creating uneven visual weight.
